description: A team to study laws and legislation under the management of experts
summary: "Orbital Advocates: A legal and policy-driven framework designed to classify historic space missions (like Apollo and Viking) as protected human heritage, establishing international rules, unified penalties, and UN oversight to prevent unauthorized commercial tampering."
details:
"Since the 1960s, humanity's first steps into outer space—such as Apollo and Viking missions—have left behind valuable historic artifacts rather than mere debris. Our project, Orbital Advocates, introduces a robust legal and policy framework to protect these abandoned sites. We propose three main pillars:
Legal Classification of space heritage.
Strict international penalty laws against unauthorized tampering by private entities.
Global enforcement governed by the United Nations in coordination with NASA.
Tools used: InShot for mobile video editing, Adobe Podcast for audio enhancement, and Canva/AI for visual design."
